relations: River 是 Ophelia 的哥哥，mate 是 siren Jazz；逃出后 River 抱 Jazz 飞天。
Dante 与 Ophelia 在电梯互念誓词结 bond，心智相连。
Grayson 是魅魔王、Dante 挚友，与 Merrily 结 mate；Merrily 曾替她杀父。
她父亲常年施虐，天使法庭拒查判疯；她自跳深渊成 nightmare，先建监狱囚父、后关 River。

facts.fact: 她砸碎第三件陶器（织了八个月魔法、只有一次机会）召唤电梯。
facts.anchor: I smashed the vase against the wall, so I wouldn't have to answer them.

facts.fact: 她把魔力从碎盘抽出裹住两位王室、向电梯魔法隐藏他们。
facts.anchor: Pulling my power out of the broken plates and wrapping it around the royals to hide them

facts.fact: River 依图织的掩护被她的魔力排斥；井中只剩细弱丝线。
facts.anchor: I reached deep into the well of power in my chest, but all I had was thin, weak threads.

facts.fact: Dante 打飞来人、Jazz 挥拳助战；River 护盾点亮挡住人群。
facts.anchor: River's magic finally blazed to life in the doorway, blocking the crowd on the other side.

facts.fact: Dante 提出共念誓词结 bond 就能出去——需要两个人。
facts.anchor: "If we seal a bond, we get out of here. I know the vows, but it takes two."

facts.fact: 互念誓词、魔力爆开心智相连；魔力之井开始加深。
facts.anchor: The burst of magic that followed was softer than I expected.

facts.fact: 她向 River 坦白不是坠落是自己跳下——因哥哥拒绝帮她逃离父亲。
facts.anchor: "I didn't just fall, River." I let out a soft breath

facts.fact: 出狱后 Dante 在车里咬腕吸血，高潮随吸血袭来。
facts.anchor: He simply lifted my wrist to his lips, and slowly bit down.
